title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“你不知道？”王多多试探得问了句。“嗯哼~”唐乐行轻应道。“呵！”王多多狡黠一笑，“夸你呢，说你能力出色，善于把握时间，争分夺秒。”唐乐行眯起眼眸，“真的？”王多多点点头，“那当然了，不然会是什么……”“我怎么觉得，你在骂我？”“怎么可能，我们又不熟，我骂你做什么。”“你想多了。”唐乐行眯着眼他盯了许久。王多多心虚别过脸，轻咳了两声。他又没有错，他俩的确不熟嘛。他可是唐乐行啊！乐安市第一大学，淮大风云榜上的头号人物。他是全校omega和beta的梦中情人，其他学校也有无数他的迷弟迷妹。完全就是众多alpha的嫉妒对象。即使毕业了，唐乐行的名声依旧。在那数万人中，也包括了他。他和唐乐行，其实见过一面。就在王多多初上大学的那一天。当年，王多多作为大一新生报到。那天他很兴奋，想要体会独立的滋味，就特意没让老王来送他。王多多挤了半天的公交车总算到了大学城站点。刚满十八岁的男孩子，天真的厉害。那时候他才知道。‘大学城’为什么会叫做‘城’。他拖着行李，照着导航沿着路，经过一幢一幢教学楼。导航说只要走半小时，他就能到。但是，半小时又半小时。大学城的路，又宽又大，像是见不到终点。他迷路了。这里好几座大学挨得很近。幸好，路上有好多和他一样的新生，他们说说笑笑得拖着行李往一个方向走了。王多多干脆便放下导航，跟着大部队一起了。

等他瞧见面前出现气派的大门，门匾上的字潦草的龙飞凤舞。他松了口气，便跟着迈了进去。结果，更晕了。这学校大得可怕。林立得教学楼，大片密林，还有贯穿全校的湖泊。王多多就是像是一只蚂蚁，掉进了巨大的黑洞，死活寻不到方向。导航不停响着。“您已偏航。”本来就迷路的人，心态都要崩了。夕阳早落了山，王多多腰酸腿软，拽着行李的手都抖得不行。他见着别的同学都是爸妈陪着来入学得，心里生出得不是羡慕，是后悔。王多多分分钟想捶地，还没力气。路道边，各个系院迎新生各个站点都收桌了。他见着那些穿着校服的学哥学姐们搬椅搬桌，突然生了怯意，不敢上前。人家都收摊了，他才来，他怕被骂。要不明天早上再来，可今晚，他得睡哪儿？王多多漫无目的得晃着，无意进了一片浓密的竹林，步过石子小道，走到头入眼竟然是一片湖，走上湖面上的廊道。过了六点，廊道栏杆闪起了一片绿光，蔓延在整片湖面上。王多多突然吓了一跳，细看后才发现那是一片片绿叶形状的景观灯。此刻周围萦绕出了一丝浪漫的意境。王多多环顾了一周，湖面中央立着一处亭子。一道身影兀然映入他的眼眸。那人很高，黑色短发，着了一身白色休闲套装。亭子里的灯光，廊道上的绿光全都打照在了那人身上。黑色得湖面，唯独亭中那一抹闪着荧光的白色背影。那人如高挂在无尽夜色中，那轮皎洁明月。那夜，那个背影，那个画面。王多多至今仍记忆犹新。男人要穿过亭子了，王多多眼见着他要走远。“哎，你等等。”王多多脱口喊了他。男人迈步的身形顿住了。他疑惑得回眸。“你喊我？”“…….”绝美的清俊容颜入了眼。“我……”王多多半张着嘴。

"You don't know?" Wang Duoduo asked tentatively."Uh-huh~" Tang Lexing responded lightly."Ha!" Wang Duoduo smiled slyly, "I'm praising you, saying that you have outstanding abilities, are good at grasping time, and race against time." Tang Lexing narrowed his eyes, "Really?" Wang Duoduo nodded, "Of course, otherwise what could it be..." "Why do I feel that you are scolding me?" "How is it possible? We are not familiar with each other, why should I scold you." "You are overthinking." Tang Lexing squinted and stared at him for a long time.Wang Duoduo turned away with a guilty conscience and coughed twice.He was not wrong, they were indeed not familiar with each other.He is Tang Lexing!The No. 1 University in Le'an City, the number one person on Huai University's prestigious list.He is the dream lover of all the omegas and betas in the school, and there are countless fans of him in other schools.He is completely the jealous object of many alphas.Even after graduation, Tang Lexing's reputation remains the same.Among those tens of thousands of people, he was included.He and Tang Lexing actually met once.On the day when Wang Duoduo first entered college.That year, Wang Duoduo registered as a freshman.He was very excited that day and wanted to experience the taste of independence, so he deliberately didn't let Lao Wang see him off.Wang Duoduo finally arrived at the University Town stop after waiting for a long time on the bus.The boy who has just turned eighteen is extremely naive.That's when he knew.Why is ‘University Town’ called ‘City’?He dragged his luggage and followed the navigation along the road, passing one teaching building after another.The navigator said he could get there in half an hour's walk.But, half hour after half hour.The road in the university town is so wide and big that there seems to be no end in sight.He is lost.There are several universities very close to each other here.Fortunately, there were many freshmen like him on the road. They were chatting and laughing while dragging their luggage in one direction.Wang Duoduo simply put down the navigation system and followed the large army.

When he saw the grand door appeared in front of him, the words on the door plaque were scrawled like dragons and phoenixes.He breathed a sigh of relief and stepped in.As a result, I became even more dizzy.This school is terrifyingly big.There are many teaching buildings, large dense forests, and lakes running through the entire school.Wang Duoduo is like an ant, falling into a huge black hole, unable to find his way.The navigation keeps beeping."You have veered off course." The mentality of the person who was already lost was about to collapse.The sun had already set, Wang Duoduo's back was sore and his legs were weak, and his hands holding the luggage were shaking.When he saw other classmates who came to school accompanied by their parents, he felt not envy but regret.Wang Duoduo wanted to punch the ground for many minutes, but he still didn't have the strength.Along the road, all the desks at the welcoming new students' stations in various departments and colleges were closed.When he saw the senior students in school uniforms moving chairs and tables, he suddenly felt timid and did not dare to step forward.He only came after everyone had closed their stalls, because he was afraid of being scolded.How about coming back tomorrow morning, but where will he sleep tonight?Wang Duoduo was wandering aimlessly and accidentally entered a dense bamboo forest. He walked along the gravel path and saw a lake at the end. He walked onto the corridor on the lake.After six o'clock, the corridor railings flashed with green light, spreading across the entire lake.Wang Duoduo was suddenly startled. After taking a closer look, he discovered that they were landscape lights in the shape of green leaves.At this moment, there was a hint of romantic mood surrounding him.Wang Duoduo looked around and saw a pavilion standing in the middle of the lake.A figure suddenly came into his eyes.The man was tall, had short black hair, and was wearing a white casual suit.The lights in the pavilion and the green light on the corridor all shone on the man.The lake was so black that only the white back of the pavilion shone with fluorescence.That person is like the bright moon hanging high in the endless night.That night, that back view, that scene.Wang Duoduo still remembers it vividly.The man was about to pass through the pavilion, and Wang Duoduo saw him walking away."Hey, wait a minute." Wang Duoduo blurted out to him.The man's figure paused as he stepped forward.He looked back in confusion."You called me?" "..." The beautiful and handsome face caught his eye."I..." Wang Duoduo opened his mouth.
